hero.title: five personal apps. one quiet place to see how they fit.
hero.lede: Live, Calorie, Setline, Kith, and Anchor each do one job and keep ownership of their own experience. The Hub brings their privacy-safe summaries together without turning them into one oversized app.
hero.note: The Hub has no public signup or checkout. Real-owner sync verification across all five apps is still in progress.

sections.title: a separate place for each part of life.
sections.lede: Every app remains useful on its own. Choose the one that matches what you need to do now.

sections.title: connection without a takeover.
sections.lede: Each product keeps its immediate data and interface. Shared contracts carry only the summaries and documented actions the Hub needs.

rows.title: keep the original record
rows.body: A workout stays with Setline. A focus session stays with Anchor. The Hub does not replace the app that created it.

rows.title: exchange a typed summary
rows.body: PersonalSyncKit and the shared backend use explicit domain contracts instead of passing around an unbounded copy of personal data.

rows.title: see the day together
rows.body: The current Hub is a private, read-only view of safe summaries. Cross-app actions will expand only after real-owner sync is verified.

closing.title: built as a system, kept honest as five products.
closing.note: Habits was absorbed into Anchor. Its historical records and compatibility contracts remain intact, but it is not another maintained product.

footer.summary: Five independently useful apps, connected only where the connection earns its place.
footer.legal: Each app owns its interface and immediate data. The Hub shows privacy-safe summaries through documented contracts.
